use_cases.name: UC1_selective
use_cases.shape: single filter + selective join (keeps 10/50, arbitrary ids)
use_cases.setup: CREATE TABLE keep AS SELECT id FROM gov LIMIT 10;
use_cases.query: SELECT g.id FROM gov g JOIN keep k ON g.id=k.id WHERE ai_filter('Does the document report on people''s health or medical services? Answer yes or no for the following government report: ' || g.summary)

use_cases.name: UC2_one_to_one
use_cases.setup: CREATE TABLE allids AS SELECT id FROM gov;
use_cases.query: SELECT g.id FROM gov g JOIN allids k ON g.id=k.id WHERE ai_filter('Does the document report on people''s health or medical services? Answer yes or no for the following government report: ' || g.summary)

use_cases.name: UC3_expansive_same
use_cases.shape: two filters on ONE relation + expansive self-join (49x)
use_cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM gov a JOIN gov b ON a.org=b.org AND a.id<>b.id WHERE ai_filter('Does the document report on people''s health or medical services? Answer yes or no for the following government report: ' || a.summary) AND ai_filter('Does the document report on national security? Answer yes or no for the following government report: ' || a.summary)

use_cases.name: UC4_split_cross
use_cases.shape: two filters SPLIT across an expansive (cross) join
use_cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM gov a JOIN gov b ON a.id<>b.id WHERE ai_filter('Does the document report on people''s health or medical services? Answer yes or no for the following government report: ' || a.summary) AND ai_filter('Does the document report on national security? Answer yes or no for the following government report: ' || b.summary)

use_cases.name: UC4_split_sparse
use_cases.shape: two filters SPLIT across a SPARSE join (each a->one b)
use_cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM gov a JOIN gov b ON a.rn=b.rn+1 WHERE ai_filter('Does the document report on people''s health or medical services? Answer yes or no for the following government report: ' || a.summary) AND ai_filter('Does the document report on national security? Answer yes or no for the following government report: ' || b.summary)

use_cases.name: UC5_classify_score_same
use_cases.shape: classify + score on ONE relation + expansive self-join (49x)
use_cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM gov a JOIN gov b ON a.org=b.org AND a.id<>b.id WHERE ai_classify(a.summary, ['health','defense','economy','education','environment','technology','justice','other']) = 'health' AND ai_score(a.summary, 'public importance') > 0.5

use_cases.name: UC6_classify_score_split
use_cases.shape: classify(a) + score(b) SPLIT across an expansive (cross) join
use_cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM gov a JOIN gov b ON a.id<>b.id WHERE ai_classify(a.summary, ['health','defense','economy','education','environment','technology','justice','other']) = 'defense' AND ai_score(b.summary, 'national security relevance') > 0.5

use_cases.name: UC7_complete_filter_same
use_cases.shape: complete + ai_filter on ONE relation + expansive self-join
use_cases.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM gov a JOIN gov b ON a.org=b.org AND a.id<>b.id WHERE ai_complete('In one word the primary topic: ' || a.summary) = 'defense' AND ai_filter('Does the document report on people''s health or medical services? Answer yes or no for the following government report: ' || a.summary)
